body.en: “Standards” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. The sheet prints main motor 45 kW and mixer motor 14 kW, output 21 m³/h, maximum outlet pressure 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, pumping distance 100 m / 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm, size 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm, weight 4500 kg. A series note says 30 series with a 400 mixer and 40/50 series with a 500 mixer. The note does not add another pipe diameter. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: “标准”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 参数表印出主电机 45 kW、搅拌电机 14 kW，输送量 21 m³/h，最大出口压力 23 MPa，料斗 0.4 m³，输送距离 100 m / 300 m，骨料 4 cm 及以下，输送管 100 / 125 mm，外形 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm，重量 4500 kg。系列说明写 30 系列配 400 搅拌、40/50 系列配 500 搅拌。这条说明没有另给管径。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: Use “Materials” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. Order the spare from the Concrete Pump Delivery Pipe page. That page is a red straight pipe with reinforced coupling ends. It has no fixed diameter table and no wall thickness. The Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump page does not print a delivery-pipe diameter. Do not copy 100 / 125 mm onto it. Electric 15 prints 100–125 mm with a dash, on a different machine. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 用“材料”看这一节在来源文章中的位置。采购时要抄的是已印片段，不是百科正文。 直管从混凝土泵输送管页询价。那一页是带加强快接端的红色直管，没有固定管径表，也没有壁厚。柴油搅拌泵一体机页面没有输送管内径。不要把 100 / 125 mm 抄过去。电动15在另一台机器上印的是带连接号的 100–125 mm。 标题到此为止。

body.en: Nothing about the phrase “Gaskets” is a second data sheet. The data-sheet fragment, if one was printed, is quoted next. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Send this model name, the inner diameter printed on its own page, the length you need, and the quantity. Do not send a wall thickness. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
